# GCF-01→18 — Culinary/Restaurant/Catering Industry Pathway (external/market)

## Grounding

Per `CYBERSECURE_BLOCKCHAIN_GALA_HOSPITALITY_LABELOS_RECONCILIATION.md`:
coverage `NONE`, distinctness `DISTINCT_PROFESSION` each (chef, pastry,
restaurant operations, catering, menu engineering, food branding — real,
standard culinary-industry careers), action `NEW_EXTERNAL` — legitimate,
no overlap with any existing Academy formation. The legacy `AGR-01`
("Transformation agroalimentaire et branding caribéen", `backend/
seed_data.py`, 40h) is explicitly **adjacent, not overlapping** — it
teaches Caribbean agro-food-industry transformation and product
branding (filière/production angle), never restaurant/culinary/
hospitality service delivery.

## Objectives

Teach the real, standard culinary-industry professional disciplines
this cluster covers, as industry-general knowledge:

- Culinary fundamentals (chef/kitchen craft), pastry arts.
- Restaurant operations and service delivery.
- Catering operations and event food service.
- Menu engineering (costing, profitability, design).
- Food branding and positioning — explicit boundary vs. `AGR-01`'s
  filière/production-transformation angle, never conflated.

## Modules

1. Culinary fundamentals and kitchen craft.
2. Pastry arts.
3. Restaurant operations and service delivery.
4. Catering operations and event food service.
5. Menu engineering (costing, profitability, design).
6. Food branding and positioning.
7. Boundary discipline — `AGR-01` (legacy) covers agro-food-industry
   transformation and product branding (production/filière angle);
   this cluster covers restaurant/culinary/catering *service delivery*
   — adjacent, never merged. `GCF-19→30` (internal operator layer) is
   `BLOCKED_PRODUCT_DEPENDENCY` — no Gala Cook & Food product/kitchen
   system exists to operate, never simulated here.

## Assessment

A discipline-literacy exam graded against real culinary-industry
practice, with an eliminatory check on conflating this cluster's
service-delivery scope with `AGR-01`'s production/filière scope, or
claiming a CVLN-operated kitchen/restaurant system exists.
